It forms a sub-section of the complex combinatorial matrices of the *Paṭṭhāna*, examining conditional relations through the intersection of the dyad of states associated with roots (*hetusampayutta-duka*) and the basic root dyad (*hetu-duka*) [DharmaNexus].
